ESTABLISHING BENCHMARKS FOR THE PRIMARY STABILITY OF FEMORAL STEMS USING FINITE ELEMENT METHODS

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now simulation_case Patient-specific
Rami Al‐Dirini, D. Huff, Dermot O’Rourke, Mark Taylor 2018-02-21 link
单位: Flinders University, Adelaide, Australia
通讯: Rami Al‐Dirini @ Flinders University, Adelaide, Australia
相关性: 该论文直接评估了髋关节假体股骨柄的初始稳定性，包括微动和界面应变，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include stress shielding analysis or intact vs implanted femur comparison.
动机· 建立Corail和Summit股骨柄初始稳定性的基准数据
方法· 基于34例股骨CT的个体化有限元模型，模拟步态和爬楼梯载荷
结果· 爬楼梯载荷下微动和界面应变更高，75百分位可作为基准指标
验证· 与已知临床存活率对比，无实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To establish benchmark data for primary stability of Corail and Summit femoral stems with known clinical survivorship.
Method· Subject-specific FE models of 34 femurs were generated from CT scans, and idealized stems were positioned using an in-house algorithm; joint and muscle forces from gait and stair climbing were applied.
Result· Stair climbing induced higher micromotion and interface strains; the 75th percentile of contact area with micromotion below 50 μm is proposed as a suitable benchmark metric.
Validation· No experimental validation; results compared qualitatively with clinical survivorship data.

HOW DOES SURGICAL VARIATION IN STEM PLACEMENT AFFECT THE PRIMARY STABILITY OF CEMENTLESS FEMORAL STEMS

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now simulation_case UQ Patient-specific
Rami Al‐Dirini, D. Huff, Marianne Taylor 2018-02-21 link
单位: Western Univ, London, Canada
通讯: Rami Al‐Dirini @ Western Univ, London, Canada
相关性: 该论文直接量化了股骨柄植入位置变异对初始稳定性的影响，包括微动和应变，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not compare intact vs implanted femur, nor does it report stress shielding or bone remodeling.
动机· 量化手术变异对骨水泥型股骨柄初始稳定性的影响。
方法· 基于患者特定有限元模型，使用拉丁超立方采样生成200种柄位置，评估微动和应变。
结果· 柄位置变异可导致微动和应变变化高达理想位置的1.5倍。
验证· 基于两个患者特定股骨模型的有限元模拟。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To systematically quantify the effect of surgical variability in stem placement on the primary stability of cementless femoral stems.
Method· Patient-specific finite element models of two femurs were generated, and an automated algorithm varied stem position using Latin Hypercube sampling to produce 200 configurations per femur, evaluating micromotion and peri-prosthetic strains.
Result· Variation in stem position led to up to 1.5 times the micromotion and strain magnitudes compared to the ideal position, with the female femur showing higher sensitivity.
Validation· The method was demonstrated on two patient-specific femurs (male and female) with no experimental validation.

Pearce Simon, Walter William, M. Gillies 2018-02-21 link
相关性: 该论文直接测量了新型股骨柄设计在尸体股骨上的皮质应变和微动，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include finite element modeling or computational simulation; it is purely experimental.
动机· 比较新型粗糙近端涂层股骨柄与现有ABGII柄的初始皮质应变和微动。
方法· 在6对新鲜冰冻尸体股骨上安装应变片，按ISO标准加载，测量植入后的应变和微动。
结果· 新型粗糙涂层柄改变了近端应变分布，可能影响骨折风险和骨整合。
验证· 尸体股骨实验验证，采用应变片和微动测量。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the initial cortical strains and micromotion of a new femoral stem with increased proximal coating roughness against the existing ABGII stem.
Method· Six pairs of fresh-frozen cadaveric femurs were instrumented with strain gauges and loaded in a single-leg stance setup per ISO standards after stem implantation.
Result· The rougher proximal coating altered the strain distribution in the proximal femur, potentially affecting periprosthetic fracture risk and osseointegration.
Validation· Cadaveric experimental validation using strain gauges and micromotion measurements.

Evaluation of Femoral Strain Distribution Resulting From Implantation With Varying Stem Lengths

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Sally Arno, Joseph Fetto, Christopher Bell, Konstantinos Papadopoulos, Walker Peter 2018-02-21 link
单位: New York University-Hospital for Joint Diseases - New York City, USA
通讯: Sally Arno @ New York University-Hospital for Joint Diseases - New York City, USA
相关性: 该论文直接评估了不同长度股骨柄植入后股骨的应变分布，与用户研究方向中的应力遮挡和骨-植入物界面力学高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report micromotion values or contact/friction modeling, and uses photoelastic coating instead of quantitative strain gauges or FEA.
动机· 评估短股骨柄能否比传统长柄更好地模拟完整骨的应变分布，减少应力遮挡。
方法· 使用光弹性涂层测量六根复合股骨在完整、短柄和长柄植入后的条纹级数。
结果· 短柄的应变模式与完整骨高度一致，而长柄导致应变向远端迁移，提示应力遮挡。
验证· 通过光弹性涂层实验验证，并辅以X光确认植入位置。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine whether a short femoral stem can replicate the strain distribution of the intact femur more closely than a traditional-length stem, thereby reducing stress shielding.
Method· Photoelastic coatings were applied to six composite femurs, and fringe orders were measured under simulated single-limb stance loading for intact, short-stem, and long-stem conditions.
Result· The short stem produced a strain pattern similar to the intact femur, while the long stem caused distal migration of strain indicative of potential stress shielding.
Validation· Experimental validation using photoelastic fringe analysis on composite femurs, with radiographic confirmation of implant alignment.

动机· 比较锥形和锥形翻修髋关节假体的初始稳定性。
方法· 使用7对尸体股骨，通过微动传感器和RSA测量轴向、矢状面和冠状面的微动，并进行光弹性应变分析。
结果· 两种假体均达到临床可接受的微动，初始稳定性相当。

Motivation· To compare the primary stability of a tapered fluted modular femoral stem versus a conical fluted stem in revision hip arthroplasty with proximal bone deficiency.
Method· Seven pairs of cadaveric femora were implanted with either a tapered or conical stem, and micromotion was measured using transducers and radiostereometric analysis (RSA) under cyclic loading, while strain was assessed via photoelastic coating.
Result· Both stem designs achieved comparable primary stability with clinically acceptable micromotion levels.
Validation· Cadaveric mechanical testing with micromotion transducers, RSA, and photoelastic strain analysis.

相关性: 该论文直接评估了股骨柄长度对初始稳定性的影响，提供了患者特定的有限元分析方法和微动数据，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not compare intact vs implanted femur stress/strain distribution, nor does it report stress shielding in Gruen zones.
动机· 探究股骨柄长度缩短对初始稳定性的影响
方法· 基于31例患者的CT数据构建患者特定有限元模型，分析不同柄长度下的微动
结果· 柄长度缩短至40%以下时，多孔表面微动显著增加，骨长入失败风险升高
验证· 临床患者数据驱动的有限元分析，无独立实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the relationship between stem length reduction and primary stability in cementless total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Patient-specific finite element models were constructed from preoperative and postoperative CT data of 31 hips, and micromotion at the stem-bone interface was analyzed for stems of varying lengths (100% to 30%).
Result· Stem length reduction to 40% or less led to a 50-80% decrease in the area with micromotion below 40 micrometers, indicating compromised primary stability.
Validation· The study used clinical patient data for model construction but did not include independent experimental validation.

IN VIVO ASSESSMENT OF POROUS IMPLANTS FUNCTIONALISED WITH RGD PEPTIDES IN ENHANCING OSSEOINTEGRATED AMPUTATION PROSTHESES

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Save for project animal Exp. validation
R. P. Dowling, Catherine Pendegrass, Benjamin A. Thomas, Gordon Blunn 2018-02-21 link
单位: Centre for Biomedical Engineering, University College London, Stanmore - United Kingdom
通讯: R. P. Dowling @ Centre for Biomedical Engineering, University College London, Stanmore - United Kingdom
相关性: 该论文涉及AM多孔植入物的骨整合评估，与AM生物医学材料相关，但缺乏力学表征和应力遮挡分析。
边界: This paper does not report mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or surface roughness characterization; it focuses on biological tissue response rather than mechanical performance.
动机· 评估多孔结构及RGD涂层对骨整合截肢假体皮肤-植入物界面的影响。
方法· 在羊模型中植入四种不同修饰的穿皮装置，6个月后进行组织学分析。
结果· 多孔结构和RGD涂层增加了组织长入和血管化，但对上皮向下生长无显著影响。
验证· 动物体内实验（羊模型）
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether porous titanium alloy implants combined with RGD peptide coatings enhance soft tissue seal formation at the skin-implant interface for osseointegrated amputation prostheses.
Method· Four types of transcutaneous devices (porous, porous+RGD, drilled, drilled+RGD) were implanted in an ovine tibial model for 6 months, followed by hard-grade resin histology.
Result· While no statistical difference in epithelial downgrowth was observed, porous structure and RGD coating significantly increased tissue ingrowth and revascularization.
Validation· Long-term in vivo ovine model with histological analysis.

动机· 评估多孔结构和RGD涂层对经皮骨整合假体皮肤密封性的影响
方法· 在绵羊模型中植入四种不同设计的经皮装置，6个月后组织学分析
结果· 多孔结构和RGD涂层增加了组织长入和血管化，但对上皮下移无显著影响

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether porous titanium implants combined with RGD peptide coatings can enhance soft tissue attachment at the skin-implant interface of osseointegrated amputation prostheses.
Method· Four types of transcutaneous devices (porous, porous+RGD, drilled, drilled+RGD) were implanted in a tibial ovine model for 6 months, followed by hard-grade resin histology.
Result· Porous structures and RGD coatings significantly increased tissue ingrowth and revascularization but did not statistically reduce epithelial downgrowth or improve epidermal attachment.
Validation· In vivo long-term (6-month) ovine model with histological analysis of the transcutaneous interface.

Validation· Validated against experimental measurements from the Alcator C-Mod tokamak with diagnostic error bars.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of cement mantle thickness on stem subsidence and cement behavior in cemented total hip arthroplasty using a collarless polished tapered stem.
Method· Composite femurs were implanted with CPT stems of varying sizes to create different cement mantle thicknesses; tantalum markers were injected into the cement, and specimens were subjected to 500,000 cycles of dynamic loading with micro-CT measurements before and after loading.
Result· Stem subsidence correlated positively with cement thickness; horizontal cement displacement correlated negatively with thickness; effective radial creep occurred when cement mantle was less than 2.5 mm thick and occupation ratio exceeded 60%.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To elucidate longitudinal kinematic changes of the hip joint during heels-down squatting after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Fluoroscopic images of 76 cementless THAs were analyzed using a 2D/3D registration technique to estimate hip ROM and impingement safety margin.
Result· Hip flexion ROM and posterior pelvic tilt changed significantly by 1 year postoperatively, with no further changes thereafter, and safety margin remained above 10°.
Validation· Clinical longitudinal study with 66 patients, validated by registration accuracy (rotation RMSE <1.3°, translation <2.3 mm).

Motivation· To investigate whether audible pitch changes during femoral broaching and implant insertion can be explained by acoustic physics, potentially aiding surgical judgment.

Motivation· To validate operating room ventilation data in a national arthroplasty registry and assess its association with revision due to infection after primary THA.
Method· Cox regression analysis of 103,370 primary THAs from the Norwegian Arthroplasty Register, comparing conventional ventilation, vertical LAF, and horizontal LAF.

Validation· Comparison with retrieval study data provided validation of the simulator findings.

Motivation· To compare the efficacy of topical intra-articular versus intravenous tranexamic acid in reducing blood loss during primary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A single-center randomized controlled trial with 112 patients assigned to either topical IA TXA (2g in 100cc saline) or two IV doses (1g pre-op and 1g 3h later), with all patients receiving oral factor Xa inhibitor for thromboembolism prophylaxis.
Result· Topical IA TXA was non-inferior to IV TXA in total blood loss (875.0 mL vs 1070.2 mL) and resulted in significantly lower transfusion requirements (16.1% vs 33.9%).
Validation· Clinical trial with 99% statistical power, non-inferiority margin of 10%, and assessment of thromboembolic events.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the minimum ten-year clinical and radiographic outcomes of periacetabular osteotomy via a modified Smith-Petersen approach.
Method· Retrospective review of 209 hips in 179 patients with acetabular dysplasia, assessing Harris hip score, Tonnis classification, and radiographic parameters.
Result· Significant improvements in Harris hip score, center-edge angle, and acetabular roof obliquity were observed, with a 10-year survival rate of 97%.
Validation· Clinical follow-up and radiographic analysis.

动机· 验证氧化锆增韧氧化铝陶瓷在体内的单斜相变程度。
方法· 对26个翻修陶瓷股骨头进行拉曼光谱测量，分析磨损区与非磨损区的单斜相含量。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify the in vivo monoclinic phase transformation in BIOLOX delta ceramic femoral heads and compare with accelerated aging predictions.
Method· Raman spectroscopy was performed on 26 retrieved ceramic heads to measure monoclinic content in worn and unworn regions.
Result· All retrievals showed higher monoclinic content than new heads, with worn areas exhibiting higher transformation, matching ISO aging predictions.
Validation· Comparison with ISO standard accelerated aging results.
